function.name: search_catalog
function.description: Visual retrieval over the asset catalog using the input photograph (optionally a crop of it). Returns up to k entries with id, category, source type, extent, link count, joint summary and one preview image each.

category.description: Catalog category to prefer (e.g. "StorageFurniture", "Door", "Window", "Chair", "Table", "Bottle", "Laptop"). Unknown names fall back to category-blind visual neighbours and the reply lists similar catalog category names.

query.description: Free-text note of what you are looking for. It is recorded only; the ranking is visual.

offset.description: Skip this many top-ranked entries (0-10) to page through the 20-entry retrieval list.

box_normalized.description: Optional [x0, y0, x1, y1] in 0-1 image coordinates: crop the photograph to this box before retrieval.

function.name: inspect_entry
function.description: Full description of one catalog entry: links (extent, centre, frame origin), joints (type, parent, child, pivot, axis, limits), size and units note, plus its catalog preview and renders at the rest and the opened configuration.

function.name: make_primitive
function.description: Create a primitive mesh part centred at its own origin. box: size_m=[x, y, z]; cylinder: size_m=[radius, height] (axis along z); sphere: size_m=[radius]. Returns the part_id to reference as {"type": "primitive", "part_id": ...}.

function.name: render_assembly
function.description: Validate an assembly spec and render it (two views at the rest configuration and one view with every joint at its far limit) on the ground grid; returns the images, the world bounding boxes of all links, joint pivots/axes in world coordinates, the lowest point and warnings.

function.name: submit_asset
function.description: Final answer: validate and materialise the assembly spec as the native asset (URDF + MJCF + meshes). An accepted submission ends the task; a rejected one returns the validation error.
